note: Deterministic progress reducer: reads progress.json + iteration_eval.json (relative to input.taskDir), adjusts stale_count per (new_findings_count<=0 || metric_delta<0), bumps iteration, derives status from stale_count bands, maintains healthy_streak, accumulates total_findings, mirrors last_direction (direction_entry.id)/last_metric (metric_value)/updated_at (api.nowIso). Writes via temp file then final path (best-effort atomic given read/write-only primitives; no rename available). All missing/invalid numerics coerce to safe defaults; read/write failures return label 'error' without throwing.
